name: Legion Lighting
old_description: Energy-efficient architectural LED lighting equipment since 1946
about:
Legion Lighting, based in Deer Park, New York, has been designing and manufacturing architectural LED lighting equipment since 1946. The company is a family‑owned, third‑generation business that began as a domestic lighting producer and has operated continuously from its New York plant for nearly eight decades.

The firm produces a broad line of commercial and architectural luminaires — including healthcare fixtures, task lights, stairwell lighting, linear strips, recessed and pendant fixtures, vapor‑tight and NSF‑rated units, high‑bay lights, and agricultural lighting — all fabricated in‑house. Its facility employs CAD/CAM engineering linked to computer‑integrated manufacturing (CIM) equipment and a fully automated powder‑coat finishing system, allowing customization of shape, size, lumen output, color temperature, and dimming options.

Legion serves specifiers, electrical contractors, distributors, and end users across commercial, institutional, healthcare, agricultural, and government sectors. Its product range includes New York City‑approved exit and emergency fixtures, BABA‑compliant “Made in USA” options, and ENERGY STAR‑listed LED engines, reflecting demand from public‑works and energy‑efficiency projects.

The company attributes its longevity to a “company that cares” philosophy emphasizing personalized service, on‑time delivery, and robust build quality using high‑grade raw materials. In‑house engineering and finishing capabilities enable rapid prototyping and tailored solutions for unique architectural requirements.
